lesson.title: 对数函数的变换
lesson.description: 参数、点映射、定义域与渐近线，及全部探究、例题、动手练习和节后习题。

en.title: Transformations of Logarithmic Functions
en.description: Parameters, point mapping, domains and asymptotes, with every investigation, example, Your Turn, and section exercise.

method.title: 识别水平变换
method.body: 先把真数写成 $b(x-h)$，水平乘 $1/|b|$，若 $b<0$ 则关于 $y$ 轴反射，然后平移 $h$。

method.title: 完成竖直变换
method.body: 竖直乘 $|a|$，若 $a<0$ 则关于 $x$ 轴反射，然后上下平移 $k$。用 $u=c^v$ 的点准确描图。

pitfalls: 先伸缩/反射再平移；展开真数可能隐藏平移。小于1的伸缩因子表示压缩。

en.title: Parameters and point mapping
en.summary:
For $y=a\log_c(b(x-h))+k$, require $c>0,c
e1,a
e0,b
e0$; this section mainly uses $c>1$. A base point $(u,v)$ maps to $(u/b+h,av+k)$.

method.title: Identify horizontal changes
method.body: First factor the argument as $b(x-h)$. Scale horizontally by $1/|b|$, reflect in the $y$-axis if $b<0$, then translate by $h$.

method.title: Complete vertical changes
method.body: Scale vertically by $|a|$, reflect in the $x$-axis if $a<0$, then translate vertically by $k$. Use points with $u=c^v$ for an accurate sketch.

pitfalls: Apply stretches/reflections before translations. An expanded argument can hide a shift. A scale factor below 1 compresses.

concepts.title: 定义域、渐近线与截距
concepts.summary: 真数必须满足 $b(x-h)>0$。非退化对数函数的值域为 $\mathbb R$，竖直渐近线为 $x=h$；定义域是 $b>0$ 时 $x>h$，$b<0$ 时 $x<h$。

method.title: 确定存在范围
method.body: 令真数严格大于0求定义域；令真数等于0定位渐近线，该点不属于图像。

method.title: 计算截距
method.body: $y$ 截距只在 $x=0$ 合法时计算；令 $y=0$ 得 $b(x-h)=c^{-k/a}$，故 $x=h+c^{-k/a}/b$。

pitfalls: 教材389页“只有h改变定义域”的总结需补充：b的符号也决定定义域方向。例如 $\log_c(-x)$ 的域是 $x<0$。

en.title: Domain, asymptote, and intercepts
en.summary: The argument must satisfy $b(x-h)>0$. A nondegenerate logarithmic function has range $\mathbb R$ and vertical asymptote $x=h$. Its domain is $x>h$ if $b>0$, and $x<h$ if $b<0$.

method.title: Find the allowed inputs
method.body: Solve the strict argument inequality for the domain. Set the argument to zero to locate the asymptote, which is excluded from the graph.

method.title: Calculate intercepts
method.body: Compute a $y$-intercept only if $x=0$ is allowed. At $y=0$, $b(x-h)=c^{-k/a}$, giving $x=h+c^{-k/a}/b$.

pitfalls: The statement on textbook page 389 that only h changes the domain needs a qualification: the sign of b also determines its direction. For example, $\log_c(-x)$ has domain $x<0$.

concepts.title: 由图像和已知点求方程
concepts.summary: 先用渐近线和截距判断变化种类，再把可靠的标注点代入适当形式。水平伸缩改变 $x$ 截距，竖直伸缩保留基图的 $x$ 截距。

method.title: 选择模型
method.body: 若只有水平伸缩，设 $y=\log_c(bx)$；若只有竖直伸缩，设 $y=a\log_c x$，再代入已知点求参数。

method.title: 回代检查
method.body: 将求得的方程代回标注点，并核对截距、渐近线、定义域与增减方向。

en.title: Find an equation from graphs or points
en.summary: Use the asymptote and intercepts to identify the kind of change, then substitute a reliable marked point into the appropriate form. A horizontal scaling changes the $x$-intercept; a vertical scaling preserves the base graph's $x$-intercept.

method.title: Choose the form
method.body: For a horizontal scaling alone, use $y=\log_c(bx)$. For a vertical scaling alone, use $y=a\log_c x$. Substitute a known point to solve for the parameter.

method.title: Check the result
method.body: Check the resulting equation at the marked points and verify its intercept, asymptote, domain, and direction.

concepts.title: 对数模型与单位
concepts.summary: 无底数标记的 $\log$ 是常用对数（底数10）。把已知量代入，隔离对数，再改写为指数式；结果与实际定义域相交，并按指定单位舍入。

method.title: 反解模型
method.body: $Y=A+B\log Q$ 给出 $\log Q=(Y-A)/B$，所以 $Q=10^{(Y-A)/B}>0$。

method.title: 解释与舍入
method.body: 分数转百分数乘100；计数预测取合理整数。所有中间计算保留足够位数，到最后才舍入。

en.title: Logarithmic models and units
en.summary: An unmarked $\log$ is the common logarithm (base 10). Substitute known values, isolate the logarithm, rewrite exponentially, and respect the model domain and requested rounding.

method.title: Invert the model
method.body: From $Y=A+B\log Q$, obtain $\log Q=(Y-A)/B$, hence $Q=10^{(Y-A)/B}>0$.

method.title: Interpret and round
method.body: Multiply a fraction by 100 to express a percent. Round predicted counts sensibly. Retain guard digits and round only at the end.

concepts.title: 复合变换与反函数（习题拓展）
concepts.summary: 关于直线 $y=x$ 反射就是求反函数：交换 $x,y$ 后解出 $y$。对数函数与对应指数函数互为反函数。

method.title: 复合顺序
method.body: 对已有函数 $f$ 继续变换时，横向伸缩因子 $s>0$ 产生 $f(x/s)$；再向左平移 $d$ 得 $f((x+d)/s)$。

method.title: 核对反函数范围
method.body: 反函数的定义域是原函数的值域；解指数或对数后，应再次核对真数严格为正。

en.title: Composed transformations and inverses (exercise extension)
en.summary: Reflection in $y=x$ gives the inverse: interchange $x$ and $y$, then solve for $y$. Logarithmic and corresponding exponential functions are inverses.

method.title: Respect composition order
method.body: When transforming an existing $f$, a horizontal scale factor $s>0$ gives $f(x/s)$. A subsequent translation left by $d$ gives $f((x+d)/s)$.

method.title: Check inverse domains
method.body: The inverse domain is the original range. After solving an exponential or logarithmic equation, check that each logarithm argument is strictly positive.

questions.prompt: 当刺激强度增加时，人对同样大小差异的敏感程度可能减弱。50 W与100 W灯泡的亮度差比150 W与200 W更明显；Fechner用对数曲线描述这种关系。再描述一种可能用对数曲线建模的情境。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 一个例子是声音：相同的强度增加在安静环境中比在很响的环境中更容易察觉。可用 $S=A\log(I/I_0)$ 表示相对于阈值 $I_0>0$ 的感觉量，其中 $I>0$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 这是定性建模示例，不是个人实验数据；具体常数须由测量确定。

questions.answer: 可用声音强度与感受到的响度之间的关系作为例子。

en.prompt: As a stimulus becomes stronger, people may be less sensitive to the same absolute increase. A 100-W bulb seems much brighter than a 50-W bulb, whereas 150-W and 200-W bulbs can look similar; Fechner proposed a logarithmic curve for this relation. Describe another situation that might be modelled by a logarithmic curve.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: One example is sound: the same intensity increase is more noticeable in a quiet setting than in a loud one. A possible model is $S=A\log(I/I_0)$ for intensity $I>0$ relative to a positive threshold $I_0$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: This is a qualitative modelling example, not personal experimental data; measurements would be needed to determine constants.

en.answer: An example is the relation between sound intensity and perceived loudness.
en.label: Opening question

questions.label: 章开篇问题

questions.prompt: 原图表示通过一次改变一个参数，把 $y=\log x$ 变为 $y=a\log(b(x-h))+k$。图1显示基图及第一次变化；各阶段标出一个关键点。对图1至4，描述新引入参数的作用，并写出变换后的方程。

en.prompt: The given graphs transform $y=\log x$ into $y=a\log(b(x-h))+k$ by changing one parameter at a time. Graph 1 shows the base graph and the first change, and a key point is marked at each stage. For graphs 1–4, describe the newly introduced parameter and write the transformed equation.

steps.title: Graph 1
steps.body: Graph 1: $(10,1)$ becomes $(10,3)$, so ordinates are multiplied by 3: $a=3$ and $y=3\log x$.

steps.title: Graph 2
steps.body: Graph 2: $(10,3)$ becomes $(5,3)$, so abscissas are scaled by $1/2$: $b=2$ and $y=3\log(2x)$.

steps.title: Graph 3
steps.body: Graph 3: $(5,3)$ becomes $(5,4)$, a translation up 1: $k=1$ and $y=3\log(2x)+1$.

steps.title: Graph 4
steps.body: Graph 4: $(5,4)$ becomes $(9,4)$, a translation right 4: $h=4$ and $y=3\log(2(x-4))+1$, with asymptote $x=4$.

en.answer: The successive functions are $3\log x$, $3\log(2x)$, $3\log(2x)+1$, and $3\log(2(x-4))+1$.
en.label: Investigate 1

questions.label: 探究 1

questions.prompt: 假设在第一次变换之前，把 $y=\log x$ 关于一个坐标轴反射。描述以下反射对方程的影响：(a) 关于 $x$ 轴；(b) 关于 $y$ 轴。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 关于 $x$ 轴使 $y$ 变为 $-y$，起始式为 $y=-\log x$；随后乘3、横压缩、上移1和右移4，最终为 $y=-3\log(2(x-4))+1$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 关于 $y$ 轴把输入 $x$ 换成 $-x$，起始式为 $y=\log(-x)$；同样后续变化给 $y=3\log(-2(x-4))+1$。此时域为 $x<4$。

questions.answer: (a) 使对数项的系数为负；(b) 使真数内的水平系数为负。

en.prompt: Suppose $y=\log x$ is reflected before the first transformation. Describe the effect on the equation if the reflection is in (a) the $x$-axis; (b) the $y$-axis.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Reflection in the $x$-axis negates the output, giving $y=-\log x$. The subsequent vertical factor 3, horizontal compression, and translations give $y=-3\log(2(x-4))+1$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Reflection in the $y$-axis replaces input $x$ by $-x$, giving $y=\log(-x)$. The same subsequent changes give $y=3\log(-2(x-4))+1$, with domain $x<4$.

en.answer: (a) Negate the coefficient of the logarithmic term; (b) negate the horizontal coefficient inside the argument.
en.label: Investigate 2

questions.label: 探究 2

questions.prompt: 一般地，描述 $y=a\log_c(b(x-h))+k$ 中的 $a,b,h,k$ 怎样影响 $y=\log_c x$ 的 (a) 定义域；(b) 值域；(c) 竖直渐近线。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 对合法底数和非零 $a,b$，真数限制是 $b(x-h)>0$：若 $b>0$，域为 $(h,\infty)$；若 $b<0$，域为 $(-\infty,h)$。$a,k$ 不影响域。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 对数输出遍历所有实数，非零倍数加常数仍遍历所有实数，所以值域保持 $\mathbb R$。若 $a=0$，这是退化情形，不能再作本节的对数图像讨论。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 真数趋于 $0^+$ 时靠近 $x=h$，所以竖直渐近线由 $x=0$ 变为 $x=h$。$b$ 的符号决定从哪一侧靠近。

questions.answer: 域由 $h$ 和 $b$ 的符号决定；值域为 $\mathbb R$；渐近线为 $x=h$。

en.prompt: In general, describe how $a,b,h,k$ in $y=a\log_c(b(x-h))+k$ affect the (a) domain, (b) range, and (c) vertical asymptote of $y=\log_c x$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) For a valid base and nonzero $a,b$, require $b(x-h)>0$. The domain is $(h,\infty)$ if $b>0$, and $(-\infty,h)$ if $b<0$. Neither $a$ nor $k$ changes it.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) A logarithm takes every real output. A nonzero scale and a translation preserve this, so the range remains $\mathbb R$. The case $a=0$ is degenerate and is excluded from this transformation discussion.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) The argument approaches $0^+$ as $x$ approaches $h$ from the allowed side. Thus the asymptote moves from $x=0$ to $x=h$; the sign of $b$ determines the side.

en.answer: The domain depends on $h$ and the sign of $b$; the range is $\mathbb R$; the asymptote is $x=h$.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 3

questions.label: 反思与回答 3

questions.prompt: 给定点映射：$a:(x,y)\mapsto(x,ay)$；$b:(x,y)\mapsto(x/b,y)$；$h:(x,y)\mapsto(x+h,y)$；$k:(x,y)\mapsto(x,y+k)$。怎样描述每个参数的作用？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: $a$：$(x,y)\mapsto(x,ay)$，竖直伸缩因子 $|a|$，负值另作 $x$ 轴反射。$b$：$(x,y)\mapsto(x/b,y)$，水平伸缩因子 $1/|b|$，负值另作 $y$ 轴反射。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: $h$：$(x,y)\mapsto(x+h,y)$，向右平移 $h$；$k$：$(x,y)\mapsto(x,y+k)$，向上平移 $k$。负的平移量表示相反方向。

en.prompt: The table gives these point mappings: $a:(x,y)\mapsto(x,ay)$; $b:(x,y)\mapsto(x/b,y)$; $h:(x,y)\mapsto(x+h,y)$; $k:(x,y)\mapsto(x,y+k)$. How would you describe the effects of each parameter?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $a$: $(x,y)\mapsto(x,ay)$ gives vertical factor $|a|$ and an $x$-axis reflection if negative. $b$: $(x,y)\mapsto(x/b,y)$ gives horizontal factor $1/|b|$ and a $y$-axis reflection if negative.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $h$: $(x,y)\mapsto(x+h,y)$ translates right by $h$. $k$: $(x,y)\mapsto(x,y+k)$ translates up by $k$. Negative translations go in the opposite direction.

en.label: Link the Ideas: parameter question

questions.label: 联系概念：参数旁问

questions.prompt: (a) 用变换画出 $y=\log_3(x+9)+2$ 的草图。(b) 指出：(i) 渐近线方程；(ii) 定义域和值域；(iii) $y$ 截距（若存在）；(iv) $x$ 截距（若存在）。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b-i,ii) $x+9>0$ 得 $x>-9$；渐近线为 $x=-9$，值域为 $\mathbb R$。

en.prompt: (a) Use transformations to sketch $y=\log_3(x+9)+2$. (b) Identify (i) the asymptote, (ii) domain and range, (iii) the $y$-intercept if it exists, and (iv) the $x$-intercept if it exists.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Translate $y=\log_3x$ left 9 and up 2: $(u,v)\mapsto(u-9,v+2)$. Points $(1,0),(3,1),(9,2)$ become $(-8,2),(-6,3),(0,4)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-i,ii) The restriction $x+9>0$ gives $x>-9$. The asymptote is $x=-9$ and the range is $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-iii) At $x=0$, $y=\log_3 9+2=2+2=4$, so the $y$-intercept is $(0,4)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-iv) Set $y=0$: $\log_3(x+9)=-2$, so $x+9=3^{-2}=1/9$ and $x=-80/9$. The resulting argument $1/9$ is positive.

en.answer: Asymptote $x=-9$; domain $(-9,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$; intercepts $(0,4)$ and $(-80/9,0)\approx(-8.9,0)$.
en.label: Example 1: Translations

questions.label: 例题 1：平移

questions.prompt: (a) 用变换画出 $y=\log(x-10)-1$ 的草图。(b) 指出：(i) 渐近线方程；(ii) 定义域和值域；(iii) $y$ 截距（若存在）；(iv) $x$ 截距（若存在）。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b-i,ii) $x-10>0$ 得域 $(10,\infty)$；渐近线 $x=10$，值域 $\mathbb R$。

questions.answer: 域 $(10,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$；渐近线 $x=10$；没有 $y$ 截距，$x$ 截距为 $(20,0)$。

en.prompt: (a) Use transformations to sketch $y=\log(x-10)-1$. (b) Identify (i) the asymptote, (ii) domain and range, (iii) the $y$-intercept if it exists, and (iv) the $x$-intercept if it exists.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Translate $y=\log x$ right 10 and down 1: $(u,v)\mapsto(u+10,v-1)$. Points $(1,0),(10,1),(100,2)$ become $(11,-1),(20,0),(110,1)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-i,ii) From $x-10>0$, the domain is $(10,\infty)$. The asymptote is $x=10$ and range is $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-iii) Since $x=0$ is outside the domain, there is no $y$-intercept. (b-iv) From $0=\log(x-10)-1$, obtain $x-10=10^1=10$, hence $x=20>10$.

en.label: Your Turn 1

questions.label: 动手练习 1

questions.prompt: (a) 用变换画出 $y=-\log_2(2x+6)$ 的草图。(b) 指出：(i) 渐近线方程；(ii) 定义域和值域；(iii) $y$ 截距（若存在）；(iv) $x$ 截距（若存在）。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 写成 $y=-\log_2(2(x+3))$。从 $y=\log_2x$ 水平乘 $1/2$、关于 $x$ 轴反射、再左移3；总映射为 $(u,v)\mapsto(u/2-3,-v)$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b-i,ii) $2x+6>0$ 得 $x>-3$，竖直渐近线 $x=-3$，值域 $\mathbb R$。

questions.answer: 渐近线 $x=-3$；域 $(-3,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$；$y$ 截距 $-\log_2 6\approx-2.6$，$x$ 截距 $-2.5$。

en.prompt: (a) Use transformations to sketch $y=-\log_2(2x+6)$. (b) Identify (i) the asymptote, (ii) domain and range, (iii) the $y$-intercept if it exists, and (iv) the $x$-intercept if it exists.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Write $y=-\log_2(2(x+3))$. Horizontally scale $y=\log_2x$ by $1/2$, reflect in the $x$-axis, then translate left 3: $(u,v)\mapsto(u/2-3,-v)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Points $(1,0),(2,1),(4,2),(8,3)$ become $(-2.5,0),(-2,-1),(-1,-2),(1,-3)$. Join them with a decreasing logarithmic curve.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-i,ii) The restriction $2x+6>0$ gives $x>-3$, vertical asymptote $x=-3$, and range $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-iii) At $x=0$, $y=-\log_2 6\approx-2.585$, giving approximately $(0,-2.6)$. (b-iv) $\log_2(2x+6)=0$ implies $2x+6=1$, hence $x=-5/2$; its argument is 1.

en.label: Example 2: Reflections, Stretches, and Translations

questions.label: 例题 2：反射、伸缩与平移

questions.prompt: (a) 用变换画出 $y=2\log_3(-x+1)$ 的草图。(b) 指出：(i) 渐近线方程；(ii) 定义域和值域；(iii) $y$ 截距（若存在）；(iv) $x$ 截距（若存在）。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b-i,ii) $1-x>0$ 得 $x<1$；渐近线 $x=1$，值域 $\mathbb R$。

questions.answer: 渐近线 $x=1$；域 $(-\infty,1)$，值域 $\mathbb R$；两个截距均为原点。

en.prompt: (a) Use transformations to sketch $y=2\log_3(-x+1)$. (b) Identify (i) the asymptote, (ii) domain and range, (iii) the $y$-intercept if it exists, and (iv) the $x$-intercept if it exists.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Write $2\log_3(-(x-1))$. Reflect in the $y$-axis, vertically scale by 2, then translate right 1: $(u,v)\mapsto(1-u,2v)$. Points $(1,0),(3,1),(9,2)$ become $(0,0),(-2,2),(-8,4)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-i,ii) The restriction $1-x>0$ gives $x<1$, asymptote $x=1$, and range $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-iii) At $x=0$, $y=2\log_3 1=0$. (b-iv) Setting $y=0$ gives $1-x=3^0=1$, so $x=0$, which satisfies $x<1$.

en.answer: Asymptote $x=1$; domain $(-\infty,1)$, range $\mathbb R$; both intercepts are the origin.
en.label: Your Turn 2

questions.label: 动手练习 2

questions.prompt: 原图红色曲线由蓝色曲线 $y=\log_4x$ 伸缩得到。写出红色曲线的方程。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 红图的 $x$ 截距与蓝图不同，故使用水平伸缩形式 $y=\log_4(bx)$。蓝图点 $(4,1)$ 对应红图点 $(1,1)$，水平因子是 $1/4$，故 $b=4$。

en.prompt: The red graph can be generated by stretching the blue graph of $y=\log_4x$. Write its equation.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The red graph has a different $x$-intercept, so use a horizontal scaling $y=\log_4(bx)$. The blue point $(4,1)$ corresponds to the red point $(1,1)$, giving horizontal factor $1/4$ and $b=4$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Independently substitute the red point $(4,2)$: $2=\log_4(4b)$, so $16=4b$ and $b=4$. Thus $y=\log_4(4x)$, for $x>0$.

questions.prompt: 焊工头盔的滤光罩用遮光号 $N=\frac{7(-\log T)}3+1$ 表示，其中 $T$ 为穿过滤光罩的可见光比例。遮光号在2至14之间，14最不透光。电弧焊建议用12号。求穿过12号滤光罩的可见光百分比，精确到 $0.0001\%$。

steps.title: 计算与核对

en.prompt: A welding helmet uses a filter shade whose number is $N=\frac{7(-\log T)}3+1$, where $T$ is the fraction of visible light transmitted. Shade numbers range from 2 to 14, and 14 admits the least light. Shade 12 is suggested for arc welding. Find the transmitted visible light as a percent to the nearest ten thousandth of a percent.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Substitute $N=12$: $12=-\frac73\log T+1$, so $11=-\frac73\log T$ and $\log T=-\frac{33}7$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $T=10^{-33/7}\approx0.00001930698$, which satisfies $0<T<1$. In percent this is $100T\%\approx0.001930698\%$, rounding to $0.0019\%$.

en.answer: Approximately $0.0019\%$ of visible light is transmitted.

exercises.prompt: 描述如何从 $y=\log_5x$ 得到下列各函数图像：(a) $y=\log_5(x-1)+6$；(b) $y=-4\log_5(3x)$；(c) $y=\frac12\log_5(-x)+7$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) $h=1,k=6$：右移1、上移6，映射 $(u,v)\mapsto(u+1,v+6)$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) $a=-4,b=3$：水平乘 $1/3$，竖直乘4并关于 $x$ 轴反射；映射 $(u,v)\mapsto(u/3,-4v)$。

exercises.answer: (a) 右1上6；(b) 横向因子 $1/3$、竖向因子4并关于 $x$ 轴反射；(c) 关于 $y$ 轴反射、竖向因子 $1/2$、上7。

en.prompt: Describe how each graph can be obtained from $y=\log_5x$: (a) $y=\log_5(x-1)+6$; (b) $y=-4\log_5(3x)$; (c) $y=\frac12\log_5(-x)+7$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $h=1,k=6$: translate right 1 and up 6, with mapping $(u,v)\mapsto(u+1,v+6)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) $a=-4,b=3$: horizontally scale by $1/3$, vertically scale by 4, and reflect in the $x$-axis: $(u,v)\mapsto(u/3,-4v)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) $a=1/2,b=-1,k=7$: reflect in the $y$-axis, vertically scale by $1/2$, and translate up 7: $(u,v)\mapsto(-u,v/2+7)$.

en.answer: (a) Right 1, up 6; (b) horizontal factor $1/3$, vertical factor 4, and $x$-axis reflection; (c) $y$-axis reflection, vertical factor $1/2$, and up 7.

exercises.prompt: (a) 画出 $y=\log_3x$，依次竖直伸缩因子2、向左平移3。(b) 写出最终图像的方程。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 第一式是 $y=2\log_3x$，向左3将输入换成 $x+3$，故 $y=2\log_3(x+3)$，定义域 $x>-3$。

en.prompt: (a) Sketch $y=\log_3x$, then, in order, stretch vertically by a factor of 2 about the $x$-axis and translate 3 units left. (b) Write the final equation.

steps.title: Calculate and check

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) The first image is $y=2\log_3x$. Translating left 3 replaces the input by $x+3$, giving $y=2\log_3(x+3)$, with domain $x>-3$.

exercises.prompt: (a) 画出 $y=\log_2x$，依次关于 $y$ 轴反射、竖直向上平移5。(b) 写出最终图像的方程。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 反射得到 $\log_2(-x)$，再上移5，故 $y=\log_2(-x)+5$。$-x>0$ 得域 $x<0$；值域为 $\mathbb R$。

en.prompt: (a) Sketch $y=\log_2x$, then, in order, reflect in the $y$-axis and translate vertically 5 units up. (b) Write the final equation.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Reflect $(1,0),(2,1),(4,2)$ to $(-1,0),(-2,1),(-4,2)$, then translate to $(-1,5),(-2,6),(-4,7)$. The asymptote remains $x=0$, with the curve on its left.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Reflection gives $\log_2(-x)$; translating up 5 gives $y=\log_2(-x)+5$. The condition $-x>0$ gives domain $x<0$, and the range is $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 水平因子 $1/2$、关于 $y$ 轴反射、右移8：$(u,v)\mapsto(8-u/2,v)$。取点 $(7.5,0),(6,1),(0,2)$。渐近线 $x=8$，域 $x<8$，值域 $\mathbb R$，曲线递减。

exercises.answer: 按各小问列出的点与竖直渐近线画平滑对数曲线；解析图中已标出方程。

en.prompt: Sketch each function: (a) $y=\log_2(x+4)-3$; (b) $y=-\log_3(x+1)+2$; (c) $y=\log_4(-2(x-8))$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Translate left 4 and down 3: $(u,v)\mapsto(u-4,v-3)$. Plot $(-3,-3),(-2,-2),(0,-1),(4,0)$. The asymptote is $x=-4$, the domain is $x>-4$, and the curve is increasing.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Translate left 1, reflect in the $x$-axis, and translate up 2: $(u,v)\mapsto(u-1,2-v)$. Plot $(0,2),(2,1),(8,0)$. The asymptote is $x=-1$, domain $x>-1$, and the curve decreases.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Horizontally scale by $1/2$, reflect in the $y$-axis, then translate right 8: $(u,v)\mapsto(8-u/2,v)$. Plot $(7.5,0),(6,1),(0,2)$. The asymptote is $x=8$, domain $x<8$, range $\mathbb R$, and the curve decreases.

en.answer: Draw smooth logarithmic curves through the listed points, approaching their stated vertical asymptotes; equations are labelled in the solution figure.

exercises.prompt: 对每个函数指出：(i) 渐近线方程；(ii) 定义域和值域；(iii) $y$ 截距，必要时精确到一位小数；(iv) $x$ 截距，必要时精确到一位小数。(a) $y=-5\log_3(x+3)$；(b) $y=\log_6(4(x+9))$；(c) $y=\log_5(x+3)-2$；(d) $y=-3\log_2(x+1)-6$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a-i,ii) $x+3>0$：域 $(-3,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$，渐近线 $x=-3$。(a-iii) $y(0)=-5\log_3 3=-5$。(a-iv) $\log_3(x+3)=0\Rightarrow x+3=1\Rightarrow x=-2$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c-i,ii) $x+3>0$：域 $(-3,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$，渐近线 $x=-3$。(c-iii) $y(0)=\log_5 3-2\approx-1.3174\approx-1.3$。(c-iv) $\log_5(x+3)=2\Rightarrow x+3=25\Rightarrow x=22$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (d-i,ii) $x+1>0$：域 $(-1,\infty)$，值域 $\mathbb R$，渐近线 $x=-1$。(d-iii) $y(0)=-3\log_2 1-6=-6$。(d-iv) $-3\log_2(x+1)=6\Rightarrow\log_2(x+1)=-2\Rightarrow x+1=1/4\Rightarrow x=-3/4\approx-0.8$。各截距都在其定义域内。

en.prompt: For each function identify (i) the asymptote, (ii) domain and range, (iii) the $y$-intercept, to one decimal place if necessary, and (iv) the $x$-intercept, to one decimal place if necessary: (a) $y=-5\log_3(x+3)$; (b) $y=\log_6(4(x+9))$; (c) $y=\log_5(x+3)-2$; (d) $y=-3\log_2(x+1)-6$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a-i,ii) From $x+3>0$: domain $(-3,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, asymptote $x=-3$. (a-iii) $y(0)=-5\log_3 3=-5$. (a-iv) $\log_3(x+3)=0\Rightarrow x+3=1\Rightarrow x=-2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b-i,ii) From $4(x+9)>0$: domain $(-9,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, asymptote $x=-9$. (b-iii) $y(0)=\log_6 36=2$. (b-iv) $4(x+9)=6^0=1\Rightarrow x=-35/4=-8.75\approx-8.8$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c-i,ii) From $x+3>0$: domain $(-3,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, asymptote $x=-3$. (c-iii) $y(0)=\log_5 3-2\approx-1.3174\approx-1.3$. (c-iv) $\log_5(x+3)=2\Rightarrow x+3=25\Rightarrow x=22$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (d-i,ii) From $x+1>0$: domain $(-1,\infty)$, range $\mathbb R$, asymptote $x=-1$. (d-iii) $y(0)=-3\log_2 1-6=-6$. (d-iv) $-3\log_2(x+1)=6\Rightarrow\log_2(x+1)=-2\Rightarrow x+1=1/4\Rightarrow x=-3/4\approx-0.8$. Each intercept lies in its domain.

exercises.prompt: 原图中每条红色曲线都是蓝色曲线伸缩后的图像。分别写出 (a) 至 (d) 的红色曲线方程。蓝色曲线依次是 $y=\log x$、$y=\log_8x$、$y=\log_2x$、$y=\log_4x$。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) The $x$-intercept remains 1. Blue $(10,1)$ becomes red $(10,5)$, giving vertical factor 5: $y=5\log x$.

steps.title: Calculate and check

exercises.prompt: 按顺序描述一组把 $y=\log_7x$ 变为下列函数的变换：(a) $y=\log_7(4(x+5))+6$；(b) $y=2\log_7(-\frac13(x-1))-4$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 水平因子3并关于 $y$ 轴反射，竖直因子2，再右移1、下移4。映射 $(u,v)\mapsto(1-3u,2v-4)$；域为 $x<1$。

en.prompt: Describe, in order, transformations of $y=\log_7x$ that produce (a) $y=\log_7(4(x+5))+6$; (b) $y=2\log_7(-\frac13(x-1))-4$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Horizontally scale by $1/4$, translate left 5, and translate up 6. The mapping is $(u,v)\mapsto(u/4-5,v+6)$; the argument restriction gives $x>-5$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Horizontally scale by 3 and reflect in the $y$-axis, vertically scale by 2, then translate right 1 and down 4. The mapping is $(u,v)\mapsto(1-3u,2v-4)$, with domain $x<1$.

en.answer: (a) Horizontal factor $1/4$, left 5, up 6; (b) horizontal factor 3, $y$-axis reflection, vertical factor 2, right 1, down 4.

exercises.prompt: $y=\log_3x$ 变为 $y=a\log_3(b(x-h))+k$。对每组变换求 $a,b,h,k$ 并写方程：(a) 关于 $x$ 轴反射、左移6、上移3；(b) 竖直伸缩因子5、水平伸缩因子 $1/3$；(c) 竖直伸缩因子 $3/4$、水平伸缩因子4、关于 $y$ 轴反射、右移2、下移5。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 输出取负给 $a=-1$；没有水平伸缩给 $b=1$；左6为 $h=-6$；上3为 $k=3$，所以 $y=-\log_3(x+6)+3$。

en.prompt: Transform $y=\log_3x$ to $y=a\log_3(b(x-h))+k$. Find $a,b,h,k$ and write the equation for (a) reflection in the $x$-axis, left 6 and up 3; (b) vertical factor 5 and horizontal factor $1/3$; (c) vertical factor $3/4$, horizontal factor 4, reflection in the $y$-axis, right 2 and down 5.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Negating output gives $a=-1$; no horizontal scaling gives $b=1$; left 6 means $h=-6$; up 3 means $k=3$. Thus $y=-\log_3(x+6)+3$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) $a=5$ and $1/|b|=1/3$, with no reflection, give $b=3$. Also $h=k=0$. The equation is $y=5\log_3(3x)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) $a=3/4$. Horizontal factor 4 and a $y$-axis reflection give $b=-1/4$. With $h=2,k=-5$, the equation is $y=\frac34\log_3(-\frac14(x-2))-5$, with domain $x<2$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) $-4x+12=-4(x-3)$。水平因子 $1/4$、关于 $y$ 轴反射、竖直因子5，然后右移3、下移2；映射 $(u,v)\mapsto(3-u/4,5v-2)$，域 $x<3$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) $6-x=-(x-6)$。关于 $y$ 轴反射，竖直因子 $1/4$ 并关于 $x$ 轴反射，然后右移6、上移1；映射 $(u,v)\mapsto(6-u,1-v/4)$，域 $x<6$。

exercises.answer: (a) 横向 $1/4$、$y$ 轴反射、竖向5、右3下2；(b) 两轴反射、竖向 $1/4$、右6上1。

en.prompt: Describe how each graph can be obtained from $y=\log_3x$: (a) $y=5\log_3(-4x+12)-2$; (b) $y=-\frac14\log_3(6-x)+1$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Factor $-4x+12=-4(x-3)$. Horizontally scale by $1/4$, reflect in the $y$-axis, vertically scale by 5, then translate right 3 and down 2: $(u,v)\mapsto(3-u/4,5v-2)$, with domain $x<3$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Factor $6-x=-(x-6)$. Reflect in the $y$-axis, vertically scale by $1/4$ and reflect in the $x$-axis, then translate right 6 and up 1: $(u,v)\mapsto(6-u,1-v/4)$, with domain $x<6$.

en.answer: (a) Horizontal factor $1/4$, $y$-axis reflection, vertical factor 5, right 3, down 2; (b) reflections in both axes, vertical factor $1/4$, right 6, up 1.

exercises.prompt: (a) $y=\log_3x$ 只经过竖直平移，图像经过 $(9,-4)$。求方程。(b) $y=\log_2x$ 只经过水平伸缩，图像经过 $(8,1)$。求方程。

en.prompt: (a) Only a vertical translation is applied to $y=\log_3x$ so that it passes through $(9,-4)$. Find the equation. (b) Only a horizontal stretch is applied to $y=\log_2x$ so that it passes through $(8,1)$. Find the equation.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Let $y=\log_3x+k$. Substitution gives $-4=\log_3 9+k=2+k$, so $k=-6$. Checking, $2-6=-4$. Thus $y=\log_3x-6$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Let $y=\log_2(bx)$. Then $1=\log_2(8b)$ implies $2=8b$, giving $b=1/4$. The horizontal scale factor is 4, so $y=\log_2(x/4)$. At $x=8$, $\log_2 2=1$.

exercises.prompt: 解释怎样把 $y=\log_6x$ 变换为 $\frac13(y+2)=\log_6(x-4)$ 的图像。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 从基图先竖直乘3，再右移4、下移2。总映射 $(u,v)\mapsto(u+4,3v-2)$，域 $x>4$，渐近线 $x=4$。

exercises.answer: 竖直伸缩因子3，向右4、向下2。

en.prompt: Explain how the graph of $\frac13(y+2)=\log_6(x-4)$ can be generated by transforming $y=\log_6x$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Multiply by 3 to obtain $y+2=3\log_6(x-4)$, then subtract 2: $y=3\log_6(x-4)-2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Vertically scale the base graph by 3, then translate right 4 and down 2. The mapping is $(u,v)\mapsto(u+4,3v-2)$, with domain $x>4$ and asymptote $x=4$.

en.answer: Vertically scale by 3, translate right 4 and down 2.

exercises.prompt: 地震释放的等效能量 $E$（kWh）与里氏震级 $R$ 的模型为 $R=0.67\log(0.36E)+1.46$。(a) 描述它从 $R=\log E$ 经历的变换。(b) 教材叙述：1963年魁北克Charlevoix的加拿大东部最强地震震级为7.0。按题给模型求释放的等效能量，精确到1 kWh。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 水平伸缩因子 $1/0.36=25/9$，竖直伸缩因子0.67，再上移1.46；没有反射。模型定义域为 $E>0$。

en.prompt: The equivalent earthquake energy $E$ in kWh is related to Richter magnitude $R$ by $R=0.67\log(0.36E)+1.46$. (a) Describe its transformations from $R=\log E$. (b) The textbook describes a 1963 Charlevoix, Québec earthquake of Richter magnitude 7.0 as the strongest in Eastern Canada. Using the given model, find its equivalent energy to the nearest kWh.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Horizontally scale by $1/0.36=25/9$, vertically scale by 0.67, then translate up 1.46; there is no reflection. The model domain is $E>0$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $E=10^{5.54/0.67}/0.36\approx515649042.498$ kWh (unrounded value approximately $515649042.4979$), so approximately $515649042$ kWh. Substitution returns $R=7.0$, and $E>0$. The historical description is retained as stated by the textbook; the calculation uses its supplied magnitude and model.

steps.title: Calculate and check

exercises.prompt: $f(x)=\log_8x$ 的图像也可写为 $g(x)=a\log_2x$。求 $a$。

exercises.prompt: 按所述顺序对已有图像作变换，求最终方程：(a) $y=2\log_5x-7$ 关于 $x$ 轴反射，再上移6；(b) $y=\log(6(x-3))$ 关于 $y$ 轴作水平伸缩因子3，再左移9。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 先对整个输出取负：$y=-(2\log_5x-7)=-2\log_5x+7$；再加6得 $y=-2\log_5x+13$，域仍为 $x>0$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) 水平乘3将输入换成 $x/3$：$y=\log(6(x/3-3))=\log(2x-18)$。再左移9，把整个输入 $x$ 换成 $x+9$：$y=\log(2(x+9)-18)=\log(2x)$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 原渐近线 $x=3$ 先到 $x=9$ 再到 $x=0$，与最终域 $x>0$ 一致；不能只把参数 $b$ 除3而保留原平移。

en.prompt: Find the final equation after the stated transformations of the given graph: (a) reflect $y=2\log_5x-7$ in the $x$-axis, then translate up 6; (b) horizontally stretch $y=\log(6(x-3))$ by factor 3 about the $y$-axis, then translate left 9.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) First negate the entire output: $y=-(2\log_5x-7)=-2\log_5x+7$. Adding 6 gives $y=-2\log_5x+13$, still with domain $x>0$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) A horizontal factor 3 replaces input by $x/3$: $y=\log(6(x/3-3))=\log(2x-18)$. Translating left 9 replaces the whole input $x$ by $x+9$: $y=\log(2(x+9)-18)=\log(2x)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The original asymptote $x=3$ moves first to $x=9$, then to $x=0$, agreeing with final domain $x>0$. The stretch must act on the entire original input, including its translation.

en.prompt: The graph of $f(x)=\log_2x$ is transformed to $g(x)=a\log_2x+k$ through $(1/4,-9)$ and $(16,-6)$. Find $a,k$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $\log_2(1/4)=-2$ and $\log_2 16=4$. The two points give $-2a+k=-9$ and $4a+k=-6$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Subtracting gives $6a=3$, so $a=1/2$. Then $-1+k=-9$ gives $k=-8$. At the other point, $(1/2)4-8=-6$; both inputs are positive.

exercises.prompt: $f(x)=5^x$ 依次关于 $y=x$ 反射，竖直伸缩因子 $1/4$，水平伸缩因子3，再右移4、下移1。将最终函数写成 $g(x)=a\log_c(b(x-h))+k$，求 $a,b,h,k$，并写出 $g(x)$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 关于 $y=x$ 反射先得到反函数 $y=\log_5x$，所以 $c=5$。竖直乘 $1/4$ 得 $y=\frac14\log_5x$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 水平乘3得到 $y=\frac14\log_5(x/3)$，再右移4、下移1得 $g(x)=\frac14\log_5((x-4)/3)-1$。真数为正要求 $x>4$。

en.prompt: The graph of $f(x)=5^x$ is reflected in $y=x$, vertically stretched by factor $1/4$, horizontally stretched by factor 3, then translated right 4 and down 1. In $g(x)=a\log_c(b(x-h))+k$, find $a,b,h,k$ and write $g(x)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: A horizontal factor 3 gives $y=\frac14\log_5(x/3)$. Translating right 4 and down 1 yields $g(x)=\frac14\log_5((x-4)/3)-1$. Positive argument requires $x>4$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The original exponential range is $(5,\infty)$, so the inverse domain is $x>5$, making its argument positive. Its range is $\mathbb R$.
